review.editorial: Reviewed transitions and dialogue after the preceding urgent scene, allowing practical actions and quieter reactions sufficient space; corrected ambiguous time-of-day wording.
review.continuity_or_facts: Checked who has received information versus who has only been sent it, prior independent schedules, possessions and continuing physical restrictions. No instantaneous communication or recovery is implied.
